name: UCI ITS PRIME Summer Internship
org: UC Irvine Institute of Transportation Studies
what_you_do: Work in transportation research for 8 weeks in the summer. You need no research experience.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page lists no age or grade rule. No research experience is needed.
pay_detail: Unpaid summer internship. No fee is listed.
deadline_text: The page says applications are accepted through May each year while space remains. It urges you to apply early.
how_to_apply: The page no longer explains how to apply and names no contact. Call ITS-Irvine at 949-824-5989 and ask about PRIME.
notes: Exact start and end dates are not posted on the program page. Confirm first: on 2026-11-02 the page gave no application steps or PRIME contact.
